comments.author: Xunzhuo
comments.body:
MI300X validation data that may complement this recipe:

- Image: `vllm/vllm-omni-rocm:minimax-h3@sha256:29d1946af9c69e3e0a7128c247bdc8c82437ead43fbc366fed443533cf6ce9e8`
- 4x MI300X (gfx942), BF16, Ulysses 4, text-encoder TP4, VAE PP4 tile
- `--diffusion-attention-backend FLASH_ATTN` resolves to AITER packed varlen attention and is functional on gfx942
- T2VA, 50 steps, 209 frames, 1344x768: encode 0.09 s, denoise 244.04 s, decode 4.15 s, 267.42 s client E2E
- FL2VA, same shape: encode 13.98 s, denoise 257.58 s, decode 4.11 s, 287.07 s client E2E
- Both outputs validated as H.264 24 FPS with 32 kHz stereo AAC

Two image-version notes:

1. The current `minimax-h3` ROCm tag is built from pre-merge #5691 commit `0eee3b186`, so T2VA/FL2VA work, but image+audio Ref2VA lacks #5699's soundfile fallback and fails without TorchCodec.
2. Video-reference Ref2VA also needs ffmpeg, which is not bundled in that image. A `docker/Dockerfile.rocm` build from v0.26.0 completed both Ref2VA paths on MI300X.

Please avoid implying ROCm requires SDPA universally; gfx942 has a validated AITER path. It would also be useful for this support PR to update `docs/models/supported_models.md` for the hardware actually validated, while leaving MI325X/MI355X explicit until their respective evidence is included.

External recipe evidence: https://github.com/vllm-project/recipes/pull/732
